name: Clocapramine
summary: Clocapramine (Clofekton, Padrasen), also known as 3-chlorocarpipramine, is an atypical antipsychotic of the iminostilbene class which was introduced in Japan in 1974 by Yoshitomi for the treatment of schizophrenia. In addition to psychosis, clocapramine has also been used to augment antidepressants in the treatment of anxiety and panic.

pharmacology.text: Clocapramine has been reported to act as an antagonist of the D2, 5-HT2A, α1-adrenergic, and α2-adrenergic receptors, and does not inhibit the reuptake of either serotonin or norepinephrine. It has also been shown to have affinity for SIGMAR1.

uses.text: Clocapramine (Clofekton, Padrasen), also known as 3-chlorocarpipramine, is an atypical antipsychotic of the iminostilbene class which was introduced in Japan in 1974 by Yoshitomi for the treatment of schizophrenia.

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available. Antipsychotics in general can cause drowsiness, dizziness, weight gain and movement problems such as stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。一般來說，抗精神病藥可能造成嗜睡、頭暈、體重增加，以及僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安等動作問題，少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。一般来说，抗精神病药可能造成嗜睡、头晕、体重增加，以及僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安等动作问题，少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: Clocapramine is carpipramine with one extra chlorine atom on its three-ring core, a small change that alters how strongly it binds to dopamine and serotonin receptors.
fact.zh: Clocapramine 是在 carpipramine 的三環核心上多加一個氯原子，這個小改變會影響它與多巴胺和血清素受體結合的強度。
fact.zhHans: Clocapramine 是在 carpipramine 的三环内核上多加一个氯原子，这个小改变会影响它与多巴胺和血清素受体结合的强度。
